sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Loads icons, the app data store, the sign-in store, the theme toggle, and a badge piece.
sections.why: Needed to draw the bar and read the current state.

sections.name: Header (part 1)
sections.title: Reads and search and AI buttons
sections.what: Reads app data and actions, counts unread notifications, and draws the left group: a menu button for phones, a search button that opens the command palette, and the AI assistant button.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the most-used tools at the top of every screen.
sections.watch_out: The search button shows the Ctrl K hint, which works only if the command palette is listening for it.

sections.name: Header (part 2)
sections.title: Cozy desk, sound, and streak badges
sections.what: Draws the cozy desk switch, which sends a mode-change message for the page to act on, the rain sound toggle, the user name pill, and the streak and freeze token counters.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the user change mode and see streak status without leaving the page.
sections.watch_out: The freeze token count falls back to 2 when the value is missing, so a missing value looks like 2 tokens.

sections.name: Header (part 3)
sections.title: Notifications, log out, and theme
sections.what: Draws the notification bell with a pulsing dot when unread items exist, a log out button that signs the user out immediately, and the theme toggle.
sections.why: Likely reason: groups the account and display controls on the right.
sections.watch_out: Logging out happens with one click and no confirmation.

summary: Top bar of the app with search, the AI assistant, a cozy desk switch, a rain sound toggle, the user's name, streak counters, notifications, log out, and the theme toggle.
purpose: Gives quick access to the app's main controls and status from every screen.
why: Likely reason: a fixed top bar keeps shortcuts and status visible at all times.
how: Reads profile data, notifications, sound state, and actions from the store, and the current user and log out action from the sign-in store. Counts unread notifications. Draws a left group (menu button on phones, search, AI assistant, cozy desk, rain sound) and a right group (user name, streak and freeze counters, bell, log out, theme toggle).
inputs: Profile values (streak days, freeze tokens), the notification list, ambient sound state, the current user, and clicks.
outputs: Opens the command palette, the AI assistant, notifications, or the mobile menu. Toggles the rain sound, sends the cozy desk mode message, and logs the user out.
risks: Log out happens on one click with no confirmation. The freeze token count shows 2 when the value is missing, which may not match the real count. The cozy desk switch depends on another part of the app listening for its message.
debug: If a button does nothing, check the matching store action. If the user name is missing, check the sign-in store. If the freeze count looks wrong, check the freezeTokens value in the profile. If the cozy desk switch fails, search the project for the event name it sends.
